summary_en: MOLITEC STEEL will acquire up to 2,400,000 shares (10.71% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) at 262 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on November 13, 2026, with a purchase price ceiling of 628.8 million yen. The acquired shares will be cancelled on November 30, 2026, together with 153,809 existing treasury shares.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase via Self-Share Out-of-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3) and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, MOLITEC STEEL's board of directors resolved to acquire up to 2.4 million shares of its common stock via out-of-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3) at a fixed price of 262 yen per share, with a maximum expenditure of 628.8 million yen. This represents 10.71% of issued shares excluding treasury stock. The purchase order will be placed on the morning of November 13, 2026, with results announced after the transaction concludes.

All shares acquired through this transaction will be cancelled on November 30, 2026, together with 153,809 shares already held as treasury stock. The company stated that the purpose is to improve capital efficiency and to pursue flexible capital policy in response to changing business conditions.

The company noted that Japanese Steel Corporation (Nippon Steel) has indicated its intention to sell 2,244,100 shares it currently holds. Depending on the outcome, there may be changes to the company's major shareholders and principal shareholder status. Any such change will be disclosed promptly. The trading relationship between MOLITEC STEEL and Japanese Steel Corporation is not expected to be materially affected by this transaction.
